Density Centrality

Source: R/centrality-batch58.R
centrality_density_centrality.Rd

Density centrality (Ibnoulouafi and El Haziti 2018) treats the degree of a node as a mass spread over discs whose radii are the distances to the nodes around it: $$DNC(i) = \sum_{j:\,1 \le d_{ij} \le r} \frac{k_i}{\pi d_{ij}^2},$$ with \(k_i\) the degree of the node and \(d_{ij}\) the shortest-path distance.

Usage

centrality_density_centrality(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality. The measure uses density_radius (the largest distance summed over, default 3).

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order.

Details

The measure is computed on the simple undirected skeleton of the network, so direction, weights, loops and parallel edges are ignored. density_radius is 3 by default, the setting the Centrality Zoo reports for the source; Inf sums over every node that can be reached. The formula was taken from Ullah et al. (2021), who reproduce it; the 2018 article was not consulted, so the default radius is not confirmed against it. Isolated nodes score 0. A density_radius that is neither a whole number of at least one nor Inf raises a cograph_bad_parameter error. normalized = TRUE divides the scores by their maximum.

References

Ibnoulouafi, A. and El Haziti, M. (2018). Density centrality: identifying influential nodes based on area density formula. Chaos, Solitons and Fractals, 114, 69-80. doi:10.1016/j.chaos.2018.06.022 .

Ullah, A., Wang, B., Sheng, J., Long, J., Khan, N. and Sun, Z. (2021). Identification of nodes influence based on global structure model in complex networks. Scientific Reports, 11, 6173. doi:10.1038/s41598-021-84684-x .

See also

centrality_gravity, centrality.

Examples

centrality_density_centrality(regulation_net)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>   9.549297  12.891550  16.711269  12.891550   9.549297   9.549297   6.684508 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>   9.549297  12.891550   9.549297
